tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Enhance your office communication with the SNOM D335 12-SIP PoE Desk Black IP Phone Set – a professional-grade VoIP phone designed for high-demand business environments in Bangladesh. With support for 12 SIP accounts, this phone is perfect for call centers, enterprises, and corporate offices that require efficient multitasking. The high-resolution graphical display makes navigation and call management effortless, while HD wideband audio ensures crystal-clear voice quality. Power over Ethernet (PoE) allows flexible deployment without the need for extra adapters, and its ergonomic design ensures comfort during long hours of use.


Key Specifications

  • Model: SNOM D335
  • SIP Accounts: 12 configurable SIP identities/accounts
  • Display: High-resolution backlit graphical display, 4.3” screen (if exact size known, include)
  • Audio: Wideband HD audio, full-duplex speakerphone, acoustic echo cancellation
  • Connectivity: Ethernet 10/100/1000 Mbps, PoE supported
  • Function Keys: 24 programmable keys, 4 context-sensitive soft keys, 5 configurable function keys
  • Line Support: Multiple lines with visual status indicators
  • Expansion: Compatible with expansion modules for additional programmable keys
  • Protocols: SIP 2.0, support for VoIP standards and security (SRTP, TLS)
  • Design: Ergonomic black desk phone with adjustable stand, intuitive interface
  • Power: PoE powered (adapter not included)
  • Features: Call transfer, hold, forwarding, conferencing, voicemail access, BLF (Busy Lamp Field), auto-provisioning
  • Ideal For: Call centers, corporate offices, enterprise VoIP systems, and professional telecommunication setups in Bangladesh
